title: Stop agent loops that make no progress
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore’s repair loop keeps asking the same question and getting the same answer. A versioned ceiling must end as no-progress — never fake success — and nested repair must share parent budget. Graph repeating nodes additionally require an explicit stop contract at linkage (`fangore_graph_linkage_preflight`). See inspiration requirements for stop contracts[^insp-stop].
implementation:
`ConvergenceGuard` / `ConvergenceContract`; `CliInstrumentor` verb `convergence_ceiling`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
